obligations.name: repair_statement
obligations.statement: ∀ (n u v : Nat) (d a : Int) (G : List SE_cstheory_2312_a2318_Census.WEdge), u ≠ v → u < n → v < n → SE_cstheory_2312_a2318_Census.wsum (SE_cstheory_2312_a2318_Census.gstar n u v d a G) = SE_cstheory_2312_a2318_Census.total (SE_cstheory_2312_a2318_Census.wsum G) a n d

obligations.name: repair_nonvacuous
obligations.statement: ∃ (T a : Int) (n : Nat) (d : Int), 2 ≤ n ∧ SE_cstheory_2312_a2318_Census.total T a n d ≠ T + (a - ((n : Int) - 2) * d)

repair_template_chunks: def total (T a : Int) (n : Nat) (d : Int) : Int := «HOLE»
def CorrectedAccounting : Prop := ∀ (n u v : Nat) (d a : Int) (G : List WEdge), u ≠ v → u < n → v < n → wsum (gstar n u v d a G) = total (wsum G) a n d

environment.isolation: bubblewrap (no network, tmpfs HOME + ~/.elan, workspace + read-only common packages)

rule.note: closed integer expression in T, a, n, d (harness validator has no hole-grammar check; check_record.sh applies this)

reserved_names.rule: a declaration (def/theorem/lemma/abbrev/instance/structure/inductive/class/opaque/axiom/irreducible_def/alias) is rejected when its name equals a reserved identifier, or its last component equals the last component of one, or it is `_root_.`-qualified; reserved = task.json reserved_names + every identifier of the template's fixed text and the obligation statements + the record namespace + evaluator.json hole_syntax.allowed_identifiers; template declarations and obligation names are exempt; `export`, `namespace` other than the record namespace and aliasing `open` forms are rejected
